assumptions_meta.project_name: North Yorkshire Dairy Expansion (600-cow robotic unit)

scenario_labels.downside: Downside: a 2026-style trough during construction and ramp-up - milk and livestock prices -10% in 2027-28 (c.35-36ppl) and -3% in 2029, recovering to base from 2030 (R-01); yields 3% below plan in 2028-29 through the robot transition (R-04); feed and variable costs +4% in 2027-28 and +2% in 2029 (R-02); overheads +2% to 2029
scenario_labels.upside: Upside: milk price +5% (c.42ppl, the 2023-25 average level) as GB supply contracts; robot yield uplift reaches the 10% Lely budget guideline (+3% volume from 2029); variable costs -2% from scale purchasing

use_of_funds.name: Robotic milking system (10 units) and dairy plant
